label: PC² Accounts & Permissions
works: Create/edit native identities, metadata and permission checkboxes; generate/import credentials.
limits: Creating a judge account does not start its service. Managed service accounts remain protected.
alternative: Use individual accounts; start the deployed service through its lifecycle.

label: Languages & Compilers
works: Manage language definitions; choose existing isolated C++17/C++20/Python profiles.
limits: Additional languages need a compiler/runtime and trusted sandbox profile. Saving a definition alone does not install them.
alternative: Deploy and validate the language inside the isolated judge before enabling it.

label: Problem settings
works: Edit native problem identity, limits, flags, validator settings and balloon color.
limits: Only deployed isolated execution/validator policy may be active; test replacement does not rejudge.
alternative: Use trusted deployment for custom executables.

label: Groups & Divisions
works: Create/edit group names, native IDs, scoreboard visibility and account membership.
limits: Group visibility controls do not replace private/public scoreboard freeze rules.
alternative: Review membership and both scoreboard views before the event.

label: Clarification Categories
works: Create/edit active clarification categories used by the native contest.
limits: A category is a question-routing definition; it is not an announcement or an answer.
alternative: Use Questions & announcements to send messages to teams.

label: Judgement Definitions
works: Create/edit verdict names, acronyms and active state. Native Accepted remains protected.
limits: A new verdict definition does not change a submission or add execution detection.
alternative: Use the pending review queue for decisions and deployed judge support for detection.

label: Automatic Judge Clients
works: Configure enabled judge accounts and native problem filters.
limits: The corresponding isolated judge process must already be deployed; settings do not create services.
alternative: Provision the documented VM and start the judge lifecycle.

label: Contest & Team Display
works: Edit native contest title, short name, team display, login policy and advanced flags.
limits: Configuration changes do not activate a separate contest or certify imported settings.
alternative: Use Contests for independent events, and Clock & schedule for event timing.

label: Scoring Rules
works: Read/edit the installed native scoring properties, including penalties and freeze behavior.
limits: These controls use the installed scoring implementation; they do not deploy arbitrary scoring plugins.
alternative: Rehearse ties, pending approvals and public freeze before changing official rules.

label: Site Clocks
works: Inspect/edit native site clocks and explicitly start/pause their configured scope.
limits: Changing elapsed time affects official event timing; server activation and clock start are separate.
alternative: Review the site scope and schedule; pause before planned infrastructure changes.

label: Sites
works: Edit permitted native sites and connection settings; protected local loopback remains fixed.
limits: Each remote site needs a separately configured PC² server and private credentials.
alternative: Provision/test the remote site using native deployment procedures.

label: Verdict Notifications
works: Configure per-problem final-verdict suppression and cutoff rules.
limits: Preliminary verdict delivery must remain suppressed by the judging workflow policy.
alternative: Use announcements for general messages; approve held results from Submissions.

label: Balloon Settings
works: Configure native balloon printing/mail settings.
limits: Printer drivers, devices, SMTP service and delivery need separate setup; no installation or test-mail guarantee.
alternative: Use Problems for colors and Balloon delivery for acknowledgements; validate external delivery.

label: Balloon Delivery
works: List final accepted team/problem entries and confirm delivered or pending in one dialog.
limits: Acknowledgement records organizer intent, not proof of physical handover. Hidden diagnostic teams are excluded.
alternative: Arrange physical balloon distribution separately.

label: Finalization & Medals
works: Edit native medal rank thresholds, certification state and comment.
limits: Certification does not resolve pending judgements or produce an institution-approved certificate design.
alternative: Finalize decisions and verify standings before certifying; export the needed summaries.

label: Native Profiles
works: Edit existing native profile name, description and contest ID metadata.
limits: This is not a full desktop profile-switching interface or a clone of linked dashboard state.
alternative: Use Contests to create, clone, activate and archive independent managed events.

label: Connections
works: Inspect native client/site connections and disconnect permitted non-runtime connections.
limits: Critical runtime clients are protected. Native connections are not a router device inventory.
alternative: Use Team connections for observed browser presence; use router tools for network inventory.

label: Native Reports
works: Generate supported native text reports with filters and owner reauthentication.
limits: Desktop file-only native report exporters need the desktop alternative. CSV/PDF summaries are not full recovery archives.
alternative: Use the stated native desktop export or Exports & Backups as appropriate.

label: Submission Management
works: Filter submissions, adjust permitted elapsed times, recoverably remove/restore and release checkouts; request guarded rejudging.
limits: Rejudging can execute code and change official results. Bulk actions can partially complete after a connection failure.
alternative: Inspect actual state before retrying; use submission details for final-verdict review.

label: Clarification Management
works: Inspect native questions, deletion/recovery and checkout state; send answers and announcements from the main page.
limits: Private/all-team audiences must be chosen deliberately; removal does not unsend a message already read.
alternative: Check the recipient scope and retained question before confirming.

label: Private Judge Data
works: Inspect current private input/expected output and replace supported problem test pairs.
limits: Replacing current tests does not rejudge old attempts or reconstruct historical test revisions.
alternative: Keep a separate data revision archive and request an explicit rejudge when justified.

label: Account Generation & Import
works: Preview and generate/import native accounts with group membership and credential export.
limits: Generated credentials are private; creating judge/site identities does not provision services.
alternative: Use synthetic accounts for rehearsal and distribute real credentials privately.

label: Compare Source Files
works: Compare two retained source files without executing them.
limits: Text similarity is not proof of correctness, plagiarism or algorithmic equivalence.
alternative: Inspect source and retained evidence with qualified human judgement.

label: Submit on Behalf of a Team
works: Owner can submit for an active team/problem while the clock runs.
limits: Creates an official attempt and can execute code through the isolated judge; requires reauthentication.
alternative: Prefer the hidden diagnostic team for a rehearsal.

label: Contest Playback
works: Import validated native playback data and explicitly start/stop it.
limits: Only an empty technical contest; native playback starts clocks and continues after the browser closes.
alternative: Use an independent rehearsal; never replay into a real event.

label: Event Feeds
works: Inspect retained/native Event Feed definitions and status.
limits: The installed upstream add/update handlers are unimplemented; this dashboard does not claim they work.
alternative: Use supported native JSON/XML report exports, or contribute a tested upstream implementation.

label: Input Validation Results
works: Read saved native input-validation results.
limits: Arbitrary uploaded custom validators are not executed on the organizer host.
alternative: Deploy trusted isolated validator support and validate it separately.

label: Shadow CCS Status
works: Inspect Shadow CCS state and existing imported-event information.
limits: External CCS credentials/connection are not provisioned here.
alternative: Use the original native tools and a separately tested external CCS deployment.

label: Installed Java Plugins
works: List installed Java plugins and their native classes.
limits: No arbitrary JVM plugin installation, Swing windows or graphical print dialogs in the web dashboard.
alternative: Use native PC² Administrator and trusted host deployment for supported plugins.

label: Service Logs
works: Read bounded/redacted tails of known service logs.
limits: Only supported files; log contents are not proof that every external service succeeded.
alternative: Use trusted host diagnostics for deeper infrastructure inspection.

label: Reset & Recovery
works: Reset through the guarded native workflow.
limits: Requires full backup, exact event identity, owner reauthentication and explicit destructive confirmation.
alternative: Prefer a new independent contest for a new event.

label: Feature Coverage
works: Show capability status and explicit limits in this section.
limits: This is an integration map, not parity with every upstream desktop dialog.
alternative: Read the User Guide, Installation and Roadmap.

label: Organizer operating systems
works: Current deployment: macOS Apple Silicon with Lima VZ Linux ARM64 judge.
limits: This overlay is not certified on Windows/Linux organizer hosts or Intel Macs.
alternative: Contribute isolated host support and run clean-machine acceptance.

label: One-click installer and fresh-host recovery
works: Engineer-assisted setup and consistent contest backups to a new workspace.
limits: No fully validated one-click clean-machine installer or full host/VM disk restore.
alternative: Follow Installation and rehearse the whole deployment and recovery.

label: Historic test revisions and peak memory
works: Current reference tests, retained native evidence and available execution times.
limits: No guaranteed historic dataset reconstruction or trusted peak memory metric.
alternative: Use clearly labelled current-data learning replay; do not invent historical evidence.

label: Public cloud and multiple tenants
works: Private-LAN local organizer architecture with optional approved HTTPS admins.
limits: Not a certified public Internet service or multi-university tenancy layer.
alternative: Separate threat model, deployment and independent security/load review.

label: Router device inventory
works: Observed browser presence, verified session events and connection gaps.
limits: Cannot identify every router-connected device or prove uninterrupted physical network presence.
alternative: Use router administration for hardware inventory with an appropriate privacy policy.

label: Team Learning Reports
works: Private per-active-team PDFs/ZIPs, source, statements and current-data isolated replay.
limits: Only deployed C++17/C++20/Python replay; expensive for large datasets and deliberate solution/test disclosure.
alternative: Generate after the event, validate capacity and give each team only its own archive.
